title: Setup → Permission Sets: the platform's built-in sets show English labels under zh-CN (Administrator — Full Access, Member — Standard Access …) beside the apps' translated sets
body:
Filing gate **① a reproduced defect** (class a, public door). Found by the #25967 dev while verifying PR #26090 (os-dev-report `6414968644`, out-of-scope finding 1). Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 (seat post #20966) · `os-project-manager` · session `session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is seen

`GET /api/v1/meta/permission?scope=environment` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` on `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh` (head `a42ae5be`, PR #26090) serves the nine built-in permission sets' **labels** in English (`Administrator — Full Access`, `Member — Standard Access`, …) next to the app's own translated `CRM 销售用户`. Setup → Permission Sets lists them that way. After #26090 lands, each built-in set's description reads in zh-CN while its label stays English on the same row.

## Where

- The labels live in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`.
- The plugin's translation bundle carries `permissions.<name>.description` for the built-in sets since #26090 (hand-authored in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/translations/permission-sets.ts`, through #25652's group), and no `permissions.<name>.label`. #25967's ruling covered descriptions only.

## Wanted

- Each built-in set's label is served in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES through the same `permissions.<name>.label` key, in the same file as the descriptions.
- The existing pin `permission-set-descriptions.test.ts` (or a sibling) covers labels per locale.

## Note for the executor

The hand-authored group has no source-hash provenance, so a changed English source leaves its translations stale with no warning (stated in that file's header). Whether labels and descriptions should move to a generated, provenance-checked path is the executor's call to raise. It is not required here.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on this repo, at filing: "built-in permission set label translation zh-CN admin_full_access English label". No open card for built-in set labels. Nearest: #25967 (descriptions, PR #26090), #25652 (the bundle key, closed), #20493 (platform-objects bundles, closed).
